item.title: ROUNDUP: Lathrop overwhelms Ceres in 2nd half of WAC girls hoops win
item.description: After surrendering 25 points in the second quarter, Lathrop’s girls basketball team gave up 12 for the entire second half of a 76-43 Western Athletic Conference win Monday at Ceres. The Spartans (10-0 WAC, 24-0 overall) shot out to a 26-6 lead before Ceres (6-4, 13-10) came charging back.

item.title: Knights stave off late comeback from Heritage
item.description: With backcourt mate Amos Cady out on a football recruiting visit, Jake Vander Veen was thrust into a different — though not entirely unfamiliar — role for Ripon Christian on Monday in an important non-league clash with large-school opponent Heritage. item.title: Downtown Manteca needs a parking problem & the best place to create it is at Yosemite & Main
item.description: Manteca is not — or better not be — buying the asphalt lot on the northwest corner of Yosemite Avenue and Main Street to turn it completely, or in part, into a downtown municipal parking lot. Only a dolt would buy arguably the most prime piece of real estate in central Manteca to make it a public parking lot.

item.title: Evacuations in South Manteca due to natural gas pipeline leak
item.description: A landscape company – that did not call 811 before digging – struck a 4-inch natural gas line while digging in the planter area on the northeast corner of West Antone Raymus Parkway and South Main Street.

item.title: THE TOP PARK WISH: MULTI-USE REC CENTER & AQUATICS CENTER
item.description: A park is within a 10-minute walking distance of 86 percent of Manteca’s residents. That snippet of data gleaned from the Trust for Public Land is contained in the updated Parks & Recreation Master Plan being presented to the City Council when they meet tonight at 6 p.m.

item.title: One person dies in rural Ripon house fire on Monday
item.description: A person died in a fire at a home in rural Ripon early Monday morning. The fire was reported at 12:45 a.m. on Monday on West Ripon Road. Crews encountered heavy fire conditions inside a single-story, single-family home.
